title: Unmake (Tsukuyomi)
body:
Syntax: unmake

Description: Tsukuyomi caster action, usable only while you and your target are inside its shared illusion. Deals no direct Health damage, but drains 40-60 Chakra and 40-60 Stamina; advances the ordeal by one action. The ordeal ends when its hidden action limit is reached.

Date: 2026-09-27
